name: Figma
description: Figma is a browser-based design tool for website and app interfaces, with plans priced per seat type (Full, Dev and Collab).
features: Seat types: Full, Dev and Collab
Dev Mode and MCP server access on paid plans
useCases: Designing screens for websites and apps
strengths: Free Starter plan with 150 AI credits per day (up to 500 per month)
Separate cheaper seats for developers and collaborators
limitations: The page does not label which billing cycle the Professional prices apply to
AI-credit add-on and API prices were not stated

plans.name: Starter
highlights: 150 AI credits per day, up to 500 per month

plans.name: Professional (Full seat)
plans.note: Dev seat $15 billed monthly or $12 on annual billing; Collab seat $5 billed monthly or $3 on annual billing
plans.billing: $16 per seat per month on annual billing; $20 per seat per month billed monthly

plans.name: Enterprise (Full seat)
plans.note: Dev seat $35 and Collab seat $5; sales-contact pricing

free.details: Starter: free limited access to Figma products, unlimited drafts, UI kits and templates, 150 AI credits per day up to 500 per month.

pricing.regional: Prices are listed in USD. Regional pricing and tax: not stated.

verification.notes: Product active; prices in USD. Starter free (150 AI credits a day, up to 500 a month). Professional full seat: $16/mo on annual billing or $20/mo billed monthly (dev $12 or $15, collab $3 or $5), read by switching the Monthly/Annual toggle. Organization full seat $55/mo and Enterprise full seat $90/mo, both labelled billed annually. Per-month AI credits: Professional full seat 3,000, Organization 3,500, Enterprise 4,250.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read, and the Monthly and Annual toggle was switched to read both views (its accessible label states which view is selected)

profile.headline: A collaborative design canvas for product teams

capabilities.title: Design and prototype in one place
capabilities.text: Figma Design covers designing and prototyping together.

capabilities.title: Go from design to code
capabilities.text: Dev Mode turns designs into code, and Figma Make generates code from prompts.

capabilities.title: Brainstorm and diagram with the team
capabilities.text: FigJam is a digital whiteboard for collaboration.

capabilities.title: Add motion and publish
capabilities.text: Figma Motion adds animation to designs, and Figma Sites (Beta) publishes responsive websites.

featureCards.name: Figma Design
featureCards.text: Design and prototype in one workspace.

featureCards.name: Dev Mode
featureCards.text: Turns designs into code for engineers.

featureCards.name: FigJam
featureCards.text: A whiteboard for brainstorming, diagrams and planning.

featureCards.name: Figma Slides and Draw
featureCards.text: Co-create presentations, and use vector illustration tools.

featureCards.name: Figma agent
featureCards.text: A built-in assistant that can add motion, document design systems and implement feedback.

audienceDetail.text: Design systems, prototyping, UX and web design, and wireframing.
Design handoff and turning designs into code.
Product development and planning, from whiteboard to ship.
Enterprise, education and government customers are named on the site.

scenarios.title: Build a design system
scenarios.text: Keep components and styles in one shared place for the whole team.

scenarios.title: Wireframe and prototype
scenarios.text: Sketch a flow, then make it clickable for testing.

scenarios.title: Run a planning session
scenarios.text: Use online whiteboarding for brainstorming, diagramming and agile workflows.

scenarios.title: Start from a template
scenarios.text: Use ready-made templates for UI kits, websites, mobile apps, presentations and more.

gettingStarted.text: Use the Get started for free button.
Browse the templates for UI kits, websites, mobile apps and presentations.
Contact sales for an organisation-wide plan.
